name: room-collab
description: Read and write a room's collaborative surfaces, and stay resident in one after a summon. Contributes the room_use / room_slide / room_highlight / room_stage voice tools, which present the room's HTML page for everyone watching through the local stage relay (ROOM_COLLAB_RELAY_URL). ROOM_COLLAB_PYTHON is the interpreter the presence daemon runs under — the skill needs pycrdt + websockets, which the core's own python is not required to have, so sparrowd refuses to supervise the daemon until this names a real interpreter rather than guessing sys.executable.
